Contract ManageBankCardCRUDService::modifyBankCard(cardid: Integer,cardstatus: CardStatus[NORMAL|SUSPEND|CANCEL],catalog: CardCatalog[CREDIT|DEPOSIT],password: Integer,balance: Real): Boolean {
	definition:
		card: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(c|c.CardID = cardid)
	precondition:
		card.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		card.CardID = cardid
	postcondition:
		let card: BankCard in
		card.oclIsNew() and
		BankCard.allInstance()->includes(card) and
		card.CardID = cardid and
		card.CardStatus = cardstatus and
		card.Catalog = catalog and
		card.Password = password and
		card.Balance = balance and
		result = true
}
